title: Experiment Command Centre & Trial Intelligence
database_migration: Maize Pollination Lab is upgraded additively to schema 3.0.0 after a pre-11.13 SQLite backup. Existing scientific tables/rows are preserved; new tables store the current protocol plus immutable protocol snapshots, factors, design versions, measurement requirements and audit events.
headline_features: Persistent active experiment context with true lazy top-level navigation.
Experiment Pulse, evidence-gap actions, lifecycle and protocol versioning.
First-class factors, treatment-matrix readiness, design family/replication declaration and power-planning approximation.
Reproducible randomisation versions with seed, constraints, factor matrix and allocation manifest.
Optional spatially constrained randomisation search for identical-treatment adjacency reduction.
Spatial diagnostics, experimental-unit data card, completeness/QC and protocol-linked field tasks.
Designed-experiment summaries, optional block-aware mixed model and analysis-ready G×E×M export.
Agroclimatic and Climate Space K-means exploration increased from k<=10 to k<=20 with silhouette/inertia/cluster-size diagnostics and a 20-colour map palette.
limitations: Full interactive browser verification requires the target Streamlit environment.

Split-plot, strip-plot and incomplete-block design families can be documented/mapped, but 11.13 does not falsely claim that the existing factorial allocator is a universal generator for those designs.
The power panel is a transparent planning approximation rather than design-specific simulation.
EO extraction at experimental-unit scale remains limited by sensor spatial resolution and must not be interpreted as plot measurement when pixels are too coarse.
